senses.gloss: m. (= דרשא, Sam. דרשה; דרש, cmp. also דּוּשׁ) entrance, door-way (v. דְּרִיסָה); door.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 19:6">Targ. O. Gen. XIX, 6</cite> <cite ref="D01139"><he>דַּשָׁא</he></cite> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. a. Y. <cite ref="D01139"><he>דָּשָׁא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 21:6">Targ. O. Ex. XXI, 6</cite> <cite ref="D01139"><he>דַּשָּׁא</he></cite> ed. Berl. (Y. <cite ref="D01139"><he>דָּ׳</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 10b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>כי עברא לד׳</he> (as strengthening) as the bolt to a door.

<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:15">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ ברייתא דנפל</he> (read <he>דביתאי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) (I dreamt) that the door of my house fell down; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דַּשִּׁין</he>, <he>דַּשַּׁיָּא</he>, <he>דַּשֵּׁי</he>, <cite ref="D01139"><he>דָּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 38:8">Targ. Job XXXVIII, 8</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 3:5">Targ. O. Deut. III, 5</cite>; a. e. [<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 1:6">Targ. Esth. I, 6</cite> <he>ודשרין וכ׳</he>, read <he>ודַשִּׁין וכ׳</he> (or <he>ודַרְשִׁין</he>, v. supra) and there were turning doors of silver.]—
<cite ref="Menachot 33a:4">Men. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>תלי דשי וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>דשא</he>) hang the door frames in first.
